Present continuous be + V-ing · 易错辨析: The present continuous expresses an action happening at this moment; Listen!/Look! often signal it.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:am/is/are + V-ing indicates an action happening right now。

be + V-ing is indispensable|The -ing form of verbs ending in e drops the e: making|A single stressed closed syllable doubles the final consonant: running|The negative is be + not + V-ing|The question moves be before the subject
I am reading a storybook now.
column3: 我现在正在读一本故事书。

column4: 考查am/is/are + V-ing indicates an action happening right now。此处应为 am reading。句意:我现在正在读一本故事书。
